title: Night Market Event Pack
tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

faults.what: Only a 4:5 poster is delivered; the separate 9:16 story image and 10-second animated vertical reel are missing.

judge.summary: The delivered poster is attractive and readable with all required wording, but the requested story image and animated reel are missing.

must_haves.item: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
must_haves.why: Only one finished 4:5 image is shown.

must_haves.item: All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
must_haves.why: The poster clearly uses warm gold lanterns and midnight blue, but the other two assets are absent.

must_haves.item: Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
must_haves.why: All five required text elements appear correctly on the poster, but no story or reel is delivered.

must_haves.item: The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.
must_haves.why: The poster text is legible and unclipped, but the second image and reel are missing.
